entry.author: Horowhenua District Council
entry.summary:
What happens to our food scraps once they leave the kitchen? And how much work goes into growing the food we eat?

In this episode, we catch up with Kate from Wast-ed with Kate to learn how everyday food scraps can be transformed into tasty snacks instead of ending up in landfill. Kate shares practical tips for reducing food waste and making the most of what's already in our kitchens.

We also take a trip to a local potato farm to see firsthand the hard work, time, and care that goes into growing the produce we enjoy every day.
Join us as we explore simple ways to reduce waste, appreciate our food, and make more sustainable choices.

Like, subscribe, and share to help spread the word about reducing food waste.
